title: The Secret of the Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: The echo of that voice had not yet faded, yet the burning sensation in Chen Ji's chest grew increasingly intense—the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment were pulsing frantically, as if responding to some ancient summoning.

text.content: The voice rang like an ancient temple bell, reverberating endlessly through Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He stood in place, body slightly rigid, as if pinned to the void by an invisible force. The Guardian hovered in mid-air, its ethereal form now seeming utterly real, its eyes swirling with countless trajectories of stars being born and dying—depths that struck terror into the heart.

dialogue.content: 「'Chen'...this surname is merely a rune projection I inscribed for you three thousand years ago.」The Guardian's voice carried no emotional fluctuation, yet each word cut like a blade. 「The true you bears the surname 'Tian'—Tianji, Heavenly Will, the mechanism of Heavenly Fate. Your bloodline, fundamentally, shares the same origin as mine.」

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The burning sensation in his chest grew more intense. The Tianji Record Fragment seemed to sense something, beginning to tremble violently. He下意识地 pressed his hand against his chest—his fingertips touching an area radiating intense heat. The fragment's temperature was rising rapidly, as if about to ignite his entire body.

「The same origin?」Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, each word seemingly scraped from his throat with difficulty. He abruptly raised his head, disbelief flickering in his eyes. 「You claim I share the same origin as you? I am merely an orphan from a border town in the Great Yan Kingdom, raised in the servants' quarters of the Tianqing Sect. When did I ever have any connection with a being like you?」

dialogue.content: The Guardian slightly shook its head, a complex emotion flickering in those star-like eyes. 「The 'orphan' identity you believed in is merely a cover created by the Tianji Record to protect you. The blood flowing in your veins does not belong to this realm, not to this era, not to this heaven and earth—it is the Tai Xu Tian Blood.」

text.content: Tai Xu Tian Blood—these four characters exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He had glimpsed this term in a hidden corner of the fragment, but it was merely fragmentary words, describing a supreme bloodline said to exist only at the dawn of all realms across the heavens. Those who possessed this blood could, it was said, communicate with the origin of all realms and stand above all heavenly laws.

Chen Ji's body trembled slightly, an unprecedented power awakening within him. It was an existence he had never perceived—some force that had slumbered for seventeen years, now boiling in the depths of his bloodline. He lowered his head to look at his hands, faint golden patterns barely visible flowing beneath his skin, like dormant dragon veins.

dialogue.content: 「Ten thousand years ago, as guardian of the Heavenly Will, I carried out a forbidden experiment—injecting my source blood into a mortal body.」The Guardian's voice grew low. 「That human was your ancestor. He reproduced with my bloodline, generation after generation diluting it, yet always retaining a trace of the source. And you...are the one least diluted in ten thousand years.」

choice.prompt: Faced with this shocking truth of his identity, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Since the bloodline has awakened, might as well calmly accept this power and use it to break the shackles of fate.
choices.risk_hint: Unknown power often comes with unknown costs

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, his pupils had taken on a faint golden glow. He felt the majestic power within him and a faint, composed arc curved at the corner of his lips—if Heaven wished him to bear this bloodline, then let Heaven see what kind of storm this bloodline could stir.

choices.description: This is too absurd. He'd rather believe it was the Guardian's deception than admit this sudden identity.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the bloodline awakening opportunity
choices.risk_hint: The bloodline has awakened; forcibly suppressing it may cause backlash

text.content: 「Absurd.」Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice. 「I am Chen Ji, a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, orphaned at birth, humiliated throughout my time in the sect. The so-called Tai Xu Tian Blood, my blood connection with you—why should I believe any of it?」He stared directly at the Guardian, his gaze unshaken. 「What exactly are you after?」

choices.description: Neither blindly accept nor readily deny—first thoroughly understand all the truth behind this before making a decision.
choices.visible_cost: Requires spending more time facing the Guardian
choices.risk_hint: The Guardian may not easily reveal all the truth

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the violent turmoil in his heart, pressing all emotions into the deepest depths of his eyes. He stared straight at the Guardian, his voice terrifyingly calm: 「You claim I am a descendant of your source blood. Then—why did you do it back then? What was the real purpose of the 'forbidden experiment' ten thousand years ago? What is the relationship between the Tianji Record and me?」

dialogue.content: The Guardian fell silent for a moment, a subtly elusive emotion flickering in those star-like eyes. 「The Tianji Record is, in itself, part of me.」Its voice was low and distant. 「It is not a dead object, but a fragment of my will. Ten thousand years ago, I sealed its core into your ancestor's body—that is the true origin of the 'Tianji Record.'」

text.content: Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned hot. The fragment had floated out of his body on its own, hovering before him. Strangely, it was slowly unfurling now, the runes no longer incomplete, but extending golden veins that intertwined into a complex pattern.

dialogue.content: 「The Tai Xu Tian Blood in you is the only key that can fully awaken the Tianji Record.」A note of urgency entered the Guardian's voice. 「However, this also means—the Eye of Heavenly Law has already detected your existence. It has been pursuing this bloodline for ten thousand years. Now that your bloodline is awakening...it has probably already sensed it.」

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Law—that terrifying existence that treated all seers throughout history as chess pieces. Chen Ji's heart contracted sharply. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said: the Tianji Record was merely one of the pieces set by the Heavenly Will. So what about him? Had he too always been a piece in someone's chess game?

choice.prompt: The threat of the Eye of Heavenly Law loomed imminent, and Chen Ji needed to make a decision—

choices.description: Since it has already been detected, might as well take the initiative and seize the advantage before the Eye of Heavenly Law locks onto him.
choices.visible_reward: May interrupt the Eye of Heavenly Law's tracking
choices.risk_hint: Active exposure may provoke more frantic pursuit

text.content: A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Since there was no way back, there was no need to retreat. He reached out and grasped the floating Tianji Record Fragment, the Tai Xu blood within him beginning to boil. 「Tell me, how to interfere with the Eye of Heavenly Law's tracking.」His voice was calm yet firm. 「I want to let it know that even chess pieces can turn against their players.」

choices.description: The Eye of Heavenly Law is too powerful; need to find refuge forces that can match it.
choices.risk_hint: Powerful refuge often comes with greater shackles

text.content: 「The Eye of Heavenly Law's tracking...is there a way to conceal it?」Chen Ji's voice was steady, his mind already racing. The 'Demonic Path Fog' of the Holy Sect, the shielding power of the Ancient Forbidden Land...He needed allies, needed leverage, needed enough time to lay out his plans.

The Guardian's form began to grow more ethereal, as if maintaining its manifestation had consumed massive amounts of its power. Yet just as it was about to dissipate, its voice rang out once more, lower than before: 「Remember, the incompleteness of the Tianji Record is because it was divided into three parts—the fragment in your hand is only one of them.」

dialogue.content: 「The second part is in the hands of the Eye of Heavenly Law—it has been looking for opportunities to recover it. The third part...」The Guardian's voice grew increasingly distant. 「Lies with the person you have always been searching for—your sister, Chen Nian. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key within her is precisely where the third part of the Tianji Record is sealed.」

text.content: Chen Nian—this name pierced Chen Ji's heart like a sharp blade. His sister, the girl taken away by the Holy Sect, missing for years, the person he had been secretly searching for. Her existence could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight...so it turned out she herself was intimately connected to the Tianji Record.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's whereabouts finally had a lead, and Chen Ji's choice would determine the direction of his next move—

choices.description: The news of his sister made it impossible for him to wait any longer; must immediately launch a rescue operation.
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's power is vast; reckless action would be extremely dangerous

text.content: 「Where is she?」Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, his eyes burning with suppressed fury of many years. He had searched for Chen Nian for years, never giving up. Now that he knew she was connected to the Tianji Record, knew she was in the Holy Sect's grasp...all his scheming, all his patience, would find direction in this moment.

choices.description: His sister is important, but rash action will only undo all previous efforts; must formulate a comprehensive plan.
choices.risk_hint: The longer it drags on, the more dangerous his sister's situation becomes

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. He knew better than anyone that impulse was the prelude to failure. The Holy Sect, the Water Moon Palace, the Three Great Sects...He needed more information, more leverage, more allies. 「Tell me more.」His voice regained its composure. 「About Chen Nian, about the Holy Sect, about everything.」

The Guardian's form had faded to near invisibility. Before completely dissipating, its final words came as if from an extreme distance, carrying an ineffable compassion: 「Child, the blood flowing in you is both a blessing and a curse. The Tai Xu Tian Blood will give you the power to oppose Heavenly Law, but every time you use it, you will accelerate the process of the Eye of Heavenly Law locking onto you...」

The Guardian's form completely dissolved into the void, as if it had never existed. Yet the burning sensation in Chen Ji's chest did not fade; the Tianji Record Fragment still quivered slightly, its golden runes brighter than before. He lowered his head to look at his hands, the faint golden bloodline patterns still flowing beneath his skin, like dormant dragons and serpents, ready to awaken at any moment.
